annotation_type: proposed text-only relation annotations for overlap-free NYT10m validation diagnostic sample; not official test gold
policy: Ordered head-to-tail pair; closed NYT10m relation inventory; supplied-text support includes documented motivated inference, with explicit premises and uncertainty. External entity-specific world facts are kept separate. Empty list means no supported allowed relation. Capital-to-containment and direction conventions are retained. The thesis author confirmed the inference criterion and the B08/N18 additions in chat on 6 October 2026.

annotations.rationale: Port Moresby is explicitly called the capital of Papua New Guinea. The broader containment label follows from the stated capital-of relation; the benchmark test labels co-assign capital and contains for country-capital cases.
The apparent Voltaire mentions refer to a film title, a Paris restaurant name, and a comparison with another writer. No relation between Voltaire the person and Paris is stated.
The sentence locates a planned Wal-Mart store on the West Side. The available company-to-location relation has the opposite direction from this query.

Brasília is called the capital in sentence 3 and Brazil’s administrative capital in sentence 4. The broader containment label follows from this stated country–capital relationship; the benchmark test labels co-assign capital and contains for country-capital cases.
Carlos Slim Domit is explicitly called the eldest son of Carlos Slim Helú.
Evo Morales is explicitly described as an Aymara.
Mark Mays is explicitly called a son of Lowry Mays, despite this bag’s distant-supervision NA stratum.
The two actors are mentioned as performers in the same film, which is not an allowed relation for the ordered pair.
The sentence says Ismail Merchant was buried in Mumbai and was born there.
Russia and Saudi Arabia are listed together as countries that won seats. No allowed direct relation is stated.
Mo Mowlam is explicitly said to have died at a hospice in Canterbury.
Mark Zuckerberg is explicitly called the founder of Facebook, matching the company-to-founder direction.

review_note: The 12 proposed text-only annotations were reviewed and confirmed by the thesis author on 29 September 2026. C01/C04 retain capital plus containment; C03 remains empty; C07 retains the explicit parent-child relation despite distant NA; C12 uses company -> founder direction. The aggregate test-label convention check is disclosed in protocol.md.
